releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.10
releases.body:
# Ducoro 0.4.10

0.4.10 完善 npm 包 [`magpie-ducoro`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-ducoro) 的中英文说明：安装步骤提前，明确通过 Magpie 添加插件的命令、Ducoro CLI 与后台服务要求、首次预览保存和诊断流程，以及尚未验证的兼容性范围。同步行为和管理记录格式与 0.4.9 一致。

Version 0.4.10 improves the bilingual documentation for the npm package [`magpie-ducoro`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-ducoro): installation comes first, with the Magpie plugin-add command, Ducoro CLI and background-service requirements, first-use preview/save and diagnostic steps, and compatibility verification limits. Synchronization behavior and management record formats are unchanged from 0.4.9.

在 Magpie 的「插件 → 添加插件」中输入 `magpie-ducoro@0.4.10`，或运行 `magpie plugin add magpie-ducoro@0.4.10`。单独执行 `npm install` 不会将插件注册到 Magpie。升级沿用已有兼容设置与管理记录；请先停止旧版宿主。

Enter `magpie-ducoro@0.4.10` in Magpie's **Plugins → Add a plugin**, or run `magpie plugin add magpie-ducoro@0.4.10`. An `npm install` alone does not register the plugin with Magpie. Compatible settings and management records carry forward; stop the previous host before upgrading.

完整更新说明见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) · Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.9
releases.body:
# Ducoro 0.4.9

0.4.9 将插件发布到 npm 注册表（[`magpie-ducoro`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-ducoro)），并修正安装包的 `bin` 入口路径（移除前导 `./`）：通过 npm 安装后，`magpie-ducoro-status` 诊断命令可正常调用。同步逻辑、页面行为与管理记录格式均无变化。

Version 0.4.9 publishes the plugin to the npm registry as [`magpie-ducoro`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-ducoro) and fixes the packaged `bin` entry path (dropping the leading `./`) so the `magpie-ducoro-status` diagnostic command works after an npm install. Synchronization logic, page behavior and management record formats are unchanged.

安装方式：`npm install magpie-ducoro@0.4.9`、在 Magpie 插件页面添加 `github:YE4IM/magpie-ducoro#v0.4.9`，或下载 GitHub Release 自动生成的 Source code 解压后添加绝对路径。升级沿用现有兼容设置与管理记录，无需重新配置。GitHub Release 仅提供自动生成的 Source code，不上传额外附件。

Installation: `npm install magpie-ducoro@0.4.9`, add `github:YE4IM/magpie-ducoro#v0.4.9` in Magpie's plugin settings, or download the GitHub Release's automatically generated Source code and add the extracted folder's absolute path. Compatible settings and management records carry forward without reconfiguration. GitHub Release provides only its automatically generated Source code, with no uploaded assets.

完整更新说明见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) · Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.8
releases.body:
# Ducoro 0.4.8

修复首次安装的两处连接阻塞：兼容 CLI 对不存在连接返回的 JSON `null`；创建时省略空能力映射参数，更新时仍可清空旧映射。空输出与损坏响应仍会阻止写入。

Fix two first-install connection blockers: accept the CLI’s explicit JSON `null` for an absent connection and omit empty capability references on creation, while preserving clearing on updates. Empty or malformed responses still prevent writes.

0.4.8 统一了预览、实际同步与核验的资源规则，修复导出配置禁用连接器时撤销漏报，以及同一技能同时显示“撤销”和“更新”的问题。技能扫描支持取消与总时限，并限制目录数量、深度和内容规模；中断后通过读回核验恢复管理记录，避免重复创建或接管被外部修改的资源。完整支持中英文切换，保留草稿、选择、焦点和打开的弹窗。升级沿用现有兼容设置与管理记录，无需重新配置。

Version 0.4.8 shares resource rules across previews, synchronization and verification, fixing missing connector revocations when an exported definition is disabled and skills incorrectly shown as both removed and updated. Skill scanning supports cancellation and deadlines with directory, depth and size limits. Readback after an interruption restores management records without duplicating resources or taking over externally modified content. English and Chinese language switching preserves drafts, selections, focus and open dialogs. Compatible settings and management records carry forward without reconfiguration.

发布目录已清理测试、QA、开发记录及旧打包产物，保留运行文件、界面资源、必要文档和恢复命令。GitHub Release 仅提供自动生成的 Source code，不上传额外附件。

The release tree contains runtime files, UI assets, essential documentation and recovery commands, with tests, QA output, development records and old packages removed. GitHub Release provides only its automatically generated Source code, with no uploaded assets.

完整更新说明见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) · Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)


## Validation

First connection, update, restart, removal and state compatibility checks passed (11/11), as did connection response and argument regressions (11/11), Node/Bun regressions (10/10 each), HTTP checks (23/23), Magpie host loading and MCP/skill lifecycle checks.

English validation covered 981 dictionary entries, 25 browser checks, 14 API checks, 6 CLI checks and 8 desktop/narrow-layout checks. A minor singular/plural wording issue remains, such as `1 settings categories unsaved`.

Validated on macOS arm64 with a local mock model endpoint. Windows/Linux, minimum-version compatibility and the full native-host interaction flow remain unverified.

Install: `github:YE4IM/magpie-ducoro#v0.4.8`

This existing 0.4.8 release and tag were updated with the first-install fixes. Download the GitHub-generated Source code below.

releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.7
releases.body:
本次重新发布：修复底部保存栏状态文字偏上，文字与操作按钮垂直居中；空草稿提示不再占位。

Republished: vertically center save-bar status text with its action buttons and remove empty draft-status spacing.

0.4.7 带来更贴近 Magpie 的统一界面：分组式同步设置、边界清晰的 Bot 列表、按需展开且对齐的资源编辑区，以及一致的方案、状态和备份体验。完整支持中英文切换，保留草稿、选择与焦点，并优化开关点击范围和错误提示，继续通过“预览并保存”审阅每次变更。

0.4.7 introduces a consistent Magpie-style interface with grouped sync settings, clearly bordered Bot lists, aligned resource editors that expand on demand, and unified plans, status views and backups. Full English and Chinese support preserves drafts, selections and focus when switching languages. Refined switch hit areas and clearer error messages improve everyday use, while Preview and save keeps each change reviewable.

完整更新说明见 [RELEASE-NOTES.md](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.7/RELEASE-NOTES.md) · Full notes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.7/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.4
releases.body:
## 0.4.4 — 2026-11-09

- 修复连接器摘要长度不一致造成的预览误报，统一指令及子代理目标选择。
- 方案编辑中的 Bot 勾选在列表刷新及语言切换后保留。
- 已核对且内容未变的资源不再产生操作日志写入；失败或缺失资源仍可重试。
- 自动预览短时复用本次清单，手动及保存前预览重新读取；正常完整扫描改为每五分钟，降级时保持快速轮询。
- 导入时校验操作恢复记录的时间、版本摘要、次数与依赖字段。
- 统一资源指纹、配置默认值与同步锁；开发目录保留回归测试，安装包不包含测试。
- 保持中英文文案及动态语言切换，更新页面和诊断版本号。

- Fix false connector updates and align instruction/subagent target selection with synchronization.
- Preserve plan target selections across inventory refreshes and language changes.
- Avoid durable operation writes for verified unchanged resources; reconcile missing resources during retries.
- Reuse inventory only for the immediate automatic comparison. Explicit and pre-save previews always read again.
- Reduce healthy full scans to five-minute intervals, retaining fast degraded polling.
- Validate operation timestamps, revision hashes, attempts and dependencies before backup import.
- Share fingerprints, defaults and mutation locks, and retain development regression tests outside the install package.

[完整更新记录 / Full changelog](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.4/CHANGELOG.md)
